title: Analyst, Compliance (Resolutions - Corporate Compliance)
description:
Job Title : Analyst, Compliance Business Title: Compliance Location: Gurugram GLG is seeking candidate for an Analyst role based in Gurugram, India. The individual will be part of GLGs 70-person global compliance department and would be required to provide timely and thoughtful support for global client service professionals. In this role you will develop strong actionable business skills - including time management, critical thinking, prioritization, communication, negotiation, problem solving, dispute management and project management. In addition to developing essential problem solving, time management, risk assessment and interpersonal skills you will contribute to broader compliance initiatives by analysing complex data, regulations, and situations to identify potential risks and develop effective risk mitigation strategies while developing effective communication skills. GLG attracts employees from diverse academic and professional backgrounds. We look for individuals who are passionate about our mission to transform how professionals learn and who embody GLG s values: learning and curiosity, responsibility, courage, judgment, fresh perspective, service, and integrity. As part of this role, you will be responsible for work including (but not limited to) the tasks below: Learning our compliance policies and procedures to protect the integrity of client engagements. Conduct internet-based search. Conducting reviews and evaluate the completeness, accuracy, and appropriateness of an individual or an entities profile. Identifying and applying a strong distinction between correct/incorrect business practices and escalate compliance breaches. Understanding and enforcing key requirements of firm and regulators Legal & Compliance rules and policies. Managing tasks and activities in a timely manner with complete ownership of responsibilities. Engaging with client service professionals daily to understand their needs and provide support to meet an objective of providing excellent services to Clients Partnering with different business units and work through complex situation on a day to day basis. Individual will reference existing policies; however, due to frequency of unique situations will need to research issues and, through situation-specific inquiries, propose solutions to issues. An ideal candidate will have the following: Graduate/Postgraduate with 2 years of minimum relevant industry experience i.e Compliance, Due Diligence, Risk Management. Mandatory - Fluency in English (verbal and written). Desirable but not required - Fluency (verbal & written) in Japanese and/or Korean languages skills will be given preference. Possess excellent Internet-based research skills. Familiarity with using Internet-based investigative tools would be an added advantage. Ability to multi-task and prioritize effectively, while ensuring a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. Strong interpersonal and communication (both verbal and written) skills since the role requires collaborating with cross functional teams Successful track record of working in a team environment. Adaptability to work in a dynamic environment often accompanied by stringent deadlines. Strong analytical bent of mind and structured problem-solving approach. Able to work and deliver under minimal supervision/independently. About GLG / Gerson Lehrman Group GLG is the world s leading platform for trusted human expertise. We connect global decision-makers-from hedge fund managers and private equity partners to strategy leaders at Fortune 500s-with the specific, authoritative voices required to answer their most critical questions. At GLG, you are an extension of our clients core teams. You will work at the intersection of industries and global markets, navigating high-stakes challenges across the full spectrum of their strategic initiatives. Operating within the industry s most trusted research environment, you ll help our clients capture the nuanced perspectives that drive smarter, faster business outcomes. We are a global team of pragmatic problem-solvers who mirror the intensity of the markets we serve. If you are driven by intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action, join us in reinventing the industry we invented. Gerson Lehrman Group, Inc. ( GLG ) is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, race, religion, color, marital status, disability, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Senior Manager - NBFC Compliance
description:
MobiKwik is one of India's leading Digital Financial Services platforms, serving over 167 million users and 4.4 million businesses. As a key player in fintech, MobiKwik offers services across digital payments, credit, and investments, with a strong focus on financial inclusion and regulatory governance. The position is with our subsidiary entity, MobiKwik Financial Services Private Limited, which is the NBFC.
 About the Role: 
 This role will be responsible for managing and strengthening the regulatory compliance framework for the NBFC business, ensuring adherence to RBI regulations and other applicable laws. The incumbent will work closely with business, product, risk, and operations teams to ensure all lending products, customer journeys, and processes are compliant with regulatory requirements. The role also includes managing regulatory reporting, audits, and engagement with regulators.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Regulatory Compliance & Advisory: 
 - Ensure end-to-end compliance with RBI regulations applicable to NBFC, including guidelines on digital lending, responsible business conduct, prudential norms, co-lending, etc.
 - Monitor and implement regulatory circulars, notifications, and guidelines issued by RBI and other relevant authorities.
 - Provide advisory support to lending, credit, product, and operations teams to ensure compliant product structures and customer journeys.
 - Ensure adherence to KYC, AML, Fair Practices Code, outsourcing guidelines, and digital lending norms.
 Reporting & Framework: 
 - Oversee regulatory reporting and filings (returns, disclosures, etc.) ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
 - Design, implement, and periodically update compliance policies/framework, SOPs, and internal control frameworks.
 - Maintain strong governance and handle regulatory escalations and critical compliance issues.
 Audits & Regulatory Engagement: 
 - Manage and coordinate RBI inspections, internal audits, and compliance reviews.
 - Liaise with RBI and other regulatory bodies for submissions, clarifications, and compliance matters.
 - Lead regulatory readiness for audits, inspections, circular changes, and enforcement actions.
 Operations & Risk Monitoring: 
 - Monitor and ensure timely resolution of customer grievances as per regulatory timelines.
 - Drive compliance monitoring, risk mitigation, and regulatory change management initiatives.
 - Conduct rigorous testing and assessments to ensure all operational processes remain in full alignment with industry regulations and legal requirements.
 - Proactively identify potential compliance gaps or risks within workflows and implement corrective actions to protect the organization from legal or financial liabilities.
 - Maintain meticulous documentation of all testing procedures and prepare comprehensive reports for internal stakeholders and external regulatory bodies.

Key Skills: Regulatory Compliance,Compliance,Regulatory,NBFC,Management,Senior management,Senior

Working within our global Application Security team, you will turn complex requirements into practical guidance, prepare teams for   assessments,   and help   demonstrate   that security and privacy are embedded throughout the software lifecycle.   A major focus is   organization -level   PCI Software Security Framework   (SSF)   activit ies : support product teams to achieve and   retain   PCI Secure Software Standard listings and   maintain   validation of our Secure Software Lifecycle practices. This role suits someone who combines compliance   expertise   with software development and application security knowledge. title: Accounts Executive  ( GST TDS & Compliance)
description:
Job title :Accounts Executive GST, TDS & Compliance Company: Anantham
 Location: Gurugram, Haryana
 Experience: 3+ Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 CTC: Upto 3.60LPA
 Industry Preferred: Real Estate / Construction / CA Firm Background 
 About the Role We are looking for a detail-oriented Accounts Executive to manage day-to-day accounting, GST, TDS, and statutory compliance activities. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in Tally Prime, GST and TDS compliance, reconciliations, and ROC/LLP-related filings, along with a strong understanding of accounting and Indian taxation. 
 Key Responsibilities Accounting & Bookkeeping Maintain day-to-day books of accounts in Tally Prime. Record sales, purchases, debit/credit notes, and maintain ledgers. Perform bank and vendor reconciliations. Cross-check sales and purchase records. Assist in preparation of P&L and balance sheet finalization. Pass year-end closing entries, including depreciation, provisions, and accruals. Maintain fixed asset records and depreciation calculations. 
 GST Compliance Handle GST return preparation and filing, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9/9C, and GSTR-10, wherever applicable. Perform GSTR-2A/2B reconciliation and ITC reconciliation. Handle E-Way Bill and E-Invoicing compliance. Maintain awareness of RCM and ITC eligibility provisions. Assist in GST audit and assessment-related requirements. TDS / TCS Calculate, deduct, and deposit TDS as applicable. Handle quarterly TDS returns and related compliance. Prepare and issue Form 16/16A. Reconcile TDS with Form 26AS/AIS. Handle TCS compliance, wherever applicable. Income Tax & Audit Support Assist in advance tax computation and ITR-related work. Coordinate with auditors for tax audit and Form 3CD requirements. Assist with income-tax schedules and other tax-related activities. ROC / LLP Compliance Assist in annual ROC filings for companies, including AOC-4 and MGT-7. Assist with LLP compliance, including Form-8 and Form-11. Coordinate with consultants/CA for statutory compliance requirements. 
 Required Skills Strong knowledge of accounting principles and bookkeeping. Hands-on experience in Tally Prime. Good knowledge of GST, TDS, TCS, and Income Tax compliance. Good working knowledge of MS Excel and MIS reporting. Knowledge of bank, vendor, GST, and TDS reconciliation. Understanding of ROC/LLP compliance. Ability to manage statutory deadlines and multiple compliance activities. Good attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to work independently and coordinate with consultants and auditors. 
 Qualification & Experience B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) or equivalent. CA Inter / Semi-qualified candidates preferred. 3+ years of relevant experience in accounting, GST, TDS, and statutory compliance. Experience in Real Estate, Construction, or CA Firm preferred. 
 Key Skills: 
 Accounting | Tally Prime | GST | GST Filing | TDS | TCS | Income Tax | ROC Compliance | LLP Compliance | Bank Reconciliation | Vendor Reconciliation | MIS Reporting | MS Excel | Statutory Compliance | Audit Support 
 Also, can apply at hr.ananthamprojects.com

Key Skills: Audit & Statutory Compliance,TDS,GST Filing & Reconciliation,Tally Prime & Accounting,Ability to Manage Compliance Deadlines,Income Tax & ITR Filing,Bank & Vendor Reconciliation,ROC / LLP Compliance
